provenance.notes: Verified on the official submission instructions: up to 7 pages of technical content plus extra pages only for references and the reproducibility checklist, double-blind (remove author and affiliation), AAAI two-column camera-ready style, US Letter, Type 1 or TrueType fonts, no acknowledgements for review. The package name and the many mandatory preamble lines of the AAAI author kit (aaai26.sty) are NOT on the page: start from the kit's anonymous-submission template and paste the converted text into it.

limits.text: Up to 7 pages of technical content; extra pages only for references and the reproducibility checklist.

anonymity.text: Remove all author and affiliation information; omit acknowledgements.

facts.text: Seven pages of technical content plus references and the reproducibility checklist.
Double-blind; two-column; US Letter; Type 1 or TrueType fonts.
Package aaai26 and the preamble lines.
